Interface DiceNode<T>

Type Parameters:
T - the type of the children
All Known Implementing Classes:
DiceNode.Arithmetic, DiceNode.Bound, DiceNode.Comparison, DiceNode.Constant, DiceNode.Dice, DiceNode.Group, DiceNode.Negate, DiceNode.Variable
public sealed interface DiceNode<T> permits DiceNode.Constant<T>, DiceNode.Variable<T>, DiceNode.Bound<T>, DiceNode.Dice<T>, DiceNode.Negate<T>, DiceNode.Arithmetic<T>, DiceNode.Comparison<T>, DiceNode.Group<T>
One node of a DiceExpression, whose children are of type T.

In DiceExpression.node(), the children are expressions themselves. In the function passed to DiceExpression.fold(Function), they are what that function returned for them. Either way, a switch over the permitted records tells the nodes apart: 

int depth = expression.<Integer>fold(node -> switch (node) {
    case DiceNode.Constant<Integer> constant -> 1;
    case DiceNode.Variable<Integer> variable -> 1;
    default -> 1 + Collections.max(node.children());
});
Since:
0.2.0
